title: Add a title: search-and-pick
spec: The primary success criterion. A search field; typing shows candidate cards WITH POSTERS as you type (debounced); clicking one adds it — title, year, kind, summary, artwork, IMDb link and genres all populated from T-3 with zero typing. Optional 'why' field, free text, one line. New titles append to the end of the queue with status=queued. Duplicate tmdb_id is refused with a clear message pointing at the existing entry. HARD RULE: no field for summary, poster URL, or IMDb link is ever presented to the user — if a human is typing metadata this ticket has failed. ACCEPT: adding Cowboy Bebop takes one search and one click, and the resulting record carries poster, backdrop, summary, year, kind and a working IMDb link.
